title: Vilma Santos, Ricky Lee reveal new project: ‘Tutuloy pa rin kahit anong edad’
summary: In their acceptance speeches at the 42nd Star Awards for Movies, movie legends Vilma Santos and Ricky Lee both emphasized the importance of continuing to pursue one's passions, regardless of age.
